title: Two-Pointer Swap
statement:
Use two pointers — one at the **start**, one at the **end** — and **swap** those elements in place.

Read **n** and the array. Swap the first and last elements, then print the array space-separated.
ioRules:
- Line 1: **n** (n ≥ 2)
- Line 2: **n** integers
- Output: array after swapping first and last
